TokenMeter v0.2.2 adds current GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1 pricing while retaining dated prices for older usage.

## Pricing

- Add GPT-6 Astra, including cache writes, long-context rates, and API Fast/Priority pricing.
- Add Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1 with $0.25 per million cache-read tokens; keep Sonnet 5 at its now-permanent $2/$10 input/output price.
- Apply GPT-5.6 Terra/Luna reductions from July 30 and Sol reductions from August 21, 2026; preserve earlier rates through dated revisions.
- Rebuild cost caches when the catalog changes, using each record's timestamp instead of applying today's price to all history.
- Correct Codex reasoning double-counting and cache-write/service-tier calculations.

Official change announcements specify dates, not exact instants. Historical cutoffs use 00:00 UTC. Earlier unverified history retains the previous catalog baseline; newly recognized models and counting fixes can still change previous estimates. Costs are virtual API equivalents, not subscription bills.

## Requirements

- macOS 13 Ventura or later.
- Source installations can use `bash scripts/install.sh`; the packager also supports universal builds.

## Privacy

Usage records remain local. Pricing updates do not upload prompts, logs, credentials, or cost data.
